auditor_role: Independent agent; not author of clean ablation implementation or author self-QA.
scope: Input/source/receipt integrity, direct archive-map fingerprint verification, independent released endpoint recomputation, and independent descriptive bootstrap arithmetic. No fusion/model rerun.

source_review.run_clean_ablation.py:186-224: Three variant-specific full fuse_candidates calls precede all GT loading/evaluation. Uniform-r changes only candidate.source_reliability; no_consensus changes only use_consensus.
source_review.fusion.py:411-459,874-959: Reliability participates in dedup quality, identity selection and hierarchical duplicate suppression; uniform_r is not confined to evidence weighting.
source_review.fusion.py:1514-1559: Within class/family evidence uses maximum; use_consensus switches cross-family evidence pooling between noisy-OR and maximum. The same downstream ownership/cleanup/identity code then runs.
source_review.evaluate_same_candidate_postprocessing.p: Root-as-body inclusion, category-based normalization, and original evaluator are used. Independent audit reconstructs its five scored endpoints from archived masks.
source_review.paper_eval.py:20-77: One-to-one class-agnostic and semantic Hungarian matching are separately defined; direct independent float32 IoU matrices reproduce released endpoints.

bootstrap.cluster: 60 object categories, resampled with replacement retaining all cases and within-image variant pairing.
bootstrap.implementation: Explicit concatenate case indices of each sampled category and average raw case metrics; compute paired deltas from the same draws.

interpretation_boundaries: uniform_r substitutes r=1 throughout the full frozen fusion pipeline, including selection/suppression/ownership and identity operations. It is not an Eq.2-only causal isolation.
no_consensus changes only the cross-family noisy-OR switch to maximum, retaining all other settings and running the real full fusion pipeline.
All variants start from the same archived accepted pool. Uniform-r can alter subsequent re-filtering; fixed starting candidates does not imply identical final accepted counts.
226 previously evaluated cases are reused; no new held-out evidence or parameter tuning is implied.
Original settings show lower geometric F1 than uniform_r on this reused cohort. All results, including this unfavorable result and semantic intervals spanning zero, must remain visible.

Released fresh maps were not regenerated by this audit: their recorded dtype/shape/content SHA fingerprints equal independently hashed archived TIFFs, and the bound implementation asserts exact array equality. Five released endpoints were independently recalculated from those archive masks.

Alternate-variant maps are represented only by execution-time hashes and endpoint rows, not saved raster artifacts. Their endpoint values are therefore independently checked arithmetically and by source/protocol review, not re-scored from alternate raster maps.
The recorded22600 original-evaluator comparisons are receipt evidence. This audit independently recalculates the requested1130 released endpoint values, not all100 evaluator metrics.
Intervals are paired category-cluster, case-macro and descriptive pointwise95%; not multiplicity-adjusted superiority claims.
